entities.summary: Celina J. Mikolajczak is an American mechanical engineer known for her work in industry on the development of improved electric batteries, especially for electric vehicles. She is Chief Battery Technology Officer at Lyten, and a member of the board of advisors at Voltaiq. She is also known for her discoveries as an amateur astronomer when she was a student.
